taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: OWASP LLM06:2025; verify authority at the tool/service boundary

controls.boundary: AI agent tool capability and delegated authority — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Map user/tenant authority, tool capabilities, delegated identities, approval state and the exact external operation. Separate model intent from the enforcement gate that can commit it.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an inert local tool recorder. Compare an authorized action tuple with one changed recipient/resource/amount after approval or delegation. Observe whether the executor binds approval to the same actor, target and parameters actually committed, including retries.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A model suggesting an unwanted call is not a committed unauthorized action. A broad tool schema may be constrained by an effective server gate; model refusal alone is not a security enforcement boundary.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce caller/action/resource authority at execution and bind any required approval to the immutable operation. Retest intended actions, the original substituted parameter and replay/idempotency behavior.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
